subject.title: Sub-agent timeout recovery creates duplicate API posts (idempotency gap)

question: Should OpenClaw add a core durable logical-action idempotency and replay contract for sub-agent/tool side effects, and what identity boundary should it use?
rationale: The remaining gap crosses agent, Gateway, and tool semantics; the wrong identity can either duplicate external actions or suppress legitimate repeated actions.

options.title: Design a narrow core contract
options.body: Define logical action identity, payload digest, expiry, replay, and audit behavior first, then implement the smallest core/Gateway change that protects sub-agent retries.

options.title: Limit core to exact-key dedupe
options.body: Treat shipped message-tool and Gateway exact-key idempotency as the supported core behavior and leave external API idempotency to workflows and plugins.

options.title: Route to ClawHub guidance
options.body: Keep core unchanged and direct unattended multi-agent operators to ClawHub skills plus service-specific idempotency keys.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Define logical action identity, payload digest, expiry, replay, and audit behavior first, then implement the smallest core/Gateway change that protects sub-agent retries.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting agent/Gateway contract decision, and steipete has the clearest current history signal across those paths in this checkout.
